question: This is a recruiter simulation for a fictional senior analytics and data intelligence specialist opening at a mobility marketplace. We need someone who connects customer analytics to operational decisions. What is Bolaji’s strongest relevant example, and what did he personally own?
answer: As a Global Data Analyst at Gozem, Bolaji connected customer analytics to operational decisions by building and operating an end-to-end business intelligence capability and customer intelligence platform using BigQuery, SQL, Python, scikit-learn, Looker Studio, and Google Sheets. He personally owned the data ingestion, modeling, reporting, monitoring, and insight generation, as well as designing rider and driver profiling, RFM segmentation, and cohort analysis that informed an incentive response supporting an approximately 9% improvement in driver retention.

PREVIOUS ROLE: Global Data Analyst - Gozem (November 2019 - September 2022)
Bolaji was Gozem's first data hire. He built the analytics function from the ground up: led the cloud migration of the entire data infrastructure to Google Cloud, migrating 10+ TB within a single quarter without operational interruption into a BigQuery warehouse he designed with 50+ scheduled ETL pipelines. He drove the fraud-patterns database that delivered zero unknown financial defaults, consolidated 20+ KPIs into the daily business-health report used by country managers and top management, shipped marketing segmentation supporting targeted campaigns, founded the analytics engineering function, and grew a distributed team of 4. His separate agricultural-season churn analysis informed an incentive response supporting an approximately 9% improvement in driver retention. This role is where Bolaji taught himself GCP, BigQuery, and cloud data engineering.
